liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **He's Gone** (2 reviews): Reviewer highlights a nice little jam at the end of He's Gone; The He's Gone into jam sequence is described as particularly sweet [19][21]
- **Bird Song** (1 review): Reviewer singles out the Bird Song as a long, very nice jam [13]
- **Big River** (1 review): Reviewer dislikes Brent's toy-piano-like keyboard tone, audible on Big River [23]
- **Peggy-O** (1 review): Peggy-O is named as a highlight of the show [19]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): Reviewer says the band builds nicely through China Cat and by the end of Rider energy picks up [17]

## The recordings

- **gd1981-02-26.mtx.chappell.sb02a.28383.sbefail.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 176 min; rated 3.91/5 by 11 [1]
- **gd1981-02-26.170687.mtx.seamons.ht175.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 181 min [2]. Said about its sound: Soundboard had noise reduction applied, milder than on 2/28; levels dropped early in Stranger and Jerry's guitar fluctuated [2]
- **gd81-02-26.glassberg.steinthal-cohen-vernon.20342.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 22 songs; 183 min; rated 3.75/5 by 8 [3]. Said about its sound: Audience recording conveys crowd energy without interfering with the music [18]
- **gd1981-02-26.176296.nak700.glassberg.menke.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 22 songs; 184 min [4]. Said about its sound: Pitch correction was applied to this transfer [4]
- **gd81-02-26.sbd.lutch.4597.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 21 songs; 168 min; rated 4/5 by 26 [6]. Said about its sound: Describes the soundboard as crisp, with Jerry improvising at his best; Jerry's guitar drops out toward the end of the opener, and Weir's guitar seems missing through the show; Soundboard quality is very good with a well balanced mix [15][16][19][23]
- **gd1981-02-26.149226.aud.flac2448**: audience recording; 21 songs; 169 min [8]

## Around the show

- Chicago local who attended every Uptown and Auditorium show says the crowd energy was wild, contradicting midwest low-energy claims [20]
- Author recalls the Uptown Theater lobby as beautiful and ornate, and wanted a poster after the first show [27]
- Says all three shows of the Uptown Theater February 1981 run are essential for fans of 1980s Dead [15]
- Calls this the weakest show in the run's context, finding it unspectacular and low on emotion [17]
- The 27th is said to be the favorite night of the three-night run, but this night is worthwhile [21]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1981-02-26.mtx.chappell.sb02a.28383.sbefail.flac16**: transferred by Chris Chappell; source: Matrix of SBD(4597) and AUD(20342) [1]
- **gd1981-02-26.170687.mtx.seamons.ht175.flac16**: source: Matrix by Hunter Seamons using Final Cut Pro (FLAC > AIFF > Final Cut w/EQ > AIFF CD tracking via Audacity > FLAC16 via xACT w/meta-tagging) April 1, 2025 [2]. Also: This is a matrix release that blends the soundboard with another source, smoothing the soundboard's mix issues [2]
- **gd81-02-26.glassberg.steinthal-cohen-vernon.20342.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Barry Glassberg; transferred by John Steinthal; source: Audience Recording [3]. Also: Glassberg is credited with recording the run's shows well; Barry Glassberg taped on Nak700 into Sony TCD5M with Maxell UDXLII, Dolby B; transferred by John Steinthal via Mark Cohen [3][21]
- **gd1981-02-26.176296.nak700.glassberg.menke.miller.clugston.flac2496**: source: Barry Glassberg's Master Audience Cassettes: Nakamichi 700 mics > Sony TCD5M (Maxell UDXL II) [4]. Also: Fresh transfer by Bob Menke from Glassberg's master cassettes; a Nakamichi mics source supplies a 4:19 patch in Drums [4]
- **gd81-02-26.sbd.lutch.4597.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Dick Latvala; source: Soundboard [6]
- **gd1981-02-26.149226.aud.flac2448**: taped by Rip Tompkins & Richie Stankiewicz; transferred by Andrew F.; source: Sennheiser MD-421's > MAC > 1st-Gen cassettes via Richie & Rip. [8]. Also: A different audience source, apparently taken from front of balcony, patched with crowd sections from other sources [8]

## Art and photos
